description: This file defines the GatewayConnectionController class responsible for managing connections to gateways within a larger app, including discovering gateways, establishing secure WebSocket connections, handling TLS fingerprint verification, and managing connection settings. It contains methods for auto-connection logic, network resolution including Bonjour/mDNS, and permissions management relevant to the app's gateway functionality.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionController
classes.description: Main class responsible for discovering, connecting, and managing gateway connections, including security and permissions handling.

methods.name: connectWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway, providing diagnostics.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specific discovered gateway, resolving its endpoint and handling TLS security.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Wrapper to connect to a gateway discovered earlier.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Establishes a manual connection to a given host and port, with optional TLS verification.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the last known gateway based on stored settings.

methods.name: refreshActiveGatewayRegistrationFromSettings
methods.description: Rebuilds and reapplies current gateway connection settings.

methods.name: clearPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Clears the current trust prompt state.

methods.name: acceptPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts and applies the pending TLS fingerprint trust.

methods.name: declinePendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines and dismisses the current trust prompt.

methods.name: updateFromDiscovery
methods.description: Updates internal state with latest discovered gateways.

methods.name: observeDiscovery
methods.description: Sets up observation on discovery state changes.

methods.name: maybeAutoConnect
methods.description: Attempts automatic connection based on user preferences and previous states.

methods.name: updateLastDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Stores information about the most recently discovered gateways.

methods.name: startAutoConnect
methods.description: Initiates an automatic connection using provided URL and security parameters.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveredTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a discovered gateway, considering stored fingerprint pins.

methods.name: resolveManualTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for manual connections.

methods.name: probeTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Probes a URL to read TLS fingerprint for trust verification.

methods.name: resolveServiceEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves service endpoint (.service) to host and port, possibly via mDNS.

methods.name: resolveHostPortFromBonjourEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves host and port from Bonjour (NetService) endpoint.

methods.name: buildGatewayURL
methods.description: Constructs WebSocket URL for connecting to gateway, considering TLS usage.

methods.name: resolveManualUseTLS
methods.description: Determines whether to use TLS based on host and settings.

methods.name: shouldRequireTLS
methods.description: Checks if a host should require TLS, typically non-loopback addresses.

methods.name: shouldForceTLS
methods.description: Checks domain suffix to determine if TLS is forcibly required.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a host is a loopback address (localhost, 0.0.0.0, ::).

methods.name: manualStableID
methods.description: Generates a unique stable ID for manual host:port connections.

methods.name: makeConnectOptions
methods.description: Assembles connection options, including capabilities, commands, and permissions.

methods.name: resolvedClientId
methods.description: Resolves the client ID considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: resolveManualPort
methods.description: Resolves port for manual connection, defaulting based on TLS requirement.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayName
methods.description: Resolves a display name for the device, storing defaults as needed.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Computes the set of capabilities enabled based on app settings and device features.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Determines the active set of commands that can be issued based on capabilities.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Collects current app permissions and device state for transmission.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if location authorization is granted.

methods.name: hasEventKitAccess
methods.description: Checks if access to EventKit (calendar/reminders) is granted.

methods.name: motionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if motion and pedometer features are available.
